title: File:100% reef-fish Endemism at 90 m off Kure Atoll.jpg
desc: This image is a frame from a video taken at a depth of 90 m off Kure Atoll, within the Papahānaumokuākea Marine National Monument in the Northwestern Hawaiian Islands. As far as we can determine, every species in this image is endemic to the Hawaiian Islands.
